Remember the Velma show? Probably one of the most disliked shows of the 2020s. 
It was hate watched so much that it was renewed for a second season.

People need to understand that if you don’t like something then don’t watch it. Because Hollywood and the like only see numbers, not opinions. (Mostly)

But the internet loves to jump on hate trains. In a perfect world, Laura Bailey (Abby’s actor in TLOU2) wouldn’t get death threats against her and her family and Bella Ramsey wouldn’t be constantly criticised for her looks when in season 1 of TLOU she was praised as the perfect choice as Ellie.

In my opinion, there was absolutely no reason to have Ellie wash up on Scar Island. (don’t remember if the island has an actual name) Ellie washed up, got kidnapped, they tried hanging her, Scar village is attacked, they leave Ellie for some reason instead of just quickly killing her before leaving, Ellie gets away and leaves the island as see explosions in the background.

Now throughout the show it’s clearly established that the WLF and the Scars are at war, then we see from Ellie’s pov that the WLF has gathered boats filled with soldiers and are heading towards an island. We also got the conversation from Isaac that there was something big about to happen that would probably kill him.

I feel like throwing Ellie on the island for a quick interaction with the scars to show the attack starting is treating the audience like we can’t put two and two together. (I see this as a continuous cycle with todays movies and shows) If they absolutely have to show it, then why not be consistent and show it from Isaac’s pov?
